answer.summary: A transparent, repeatable evaluation framework for agent memory under token constraints remains unestablished in current literature or benchmarks.
answer.content: The official BigBench documentation does not explicitly support or provide workflows for evaluating memory-based agents under fixed token budgets, indicating a structural gap in benchmark design for memory-centric tasks. This confirms the absence of foundational infrastructure for such evaluations, even in well-established datasets. No source currently addresses this directly, and no experimental protocol exists to document performance gaps under controlled conditions with explicit baseline reporting.

answer.lesson: Agent memory evaluation requires explicit support in benchmark frameworks for memory state tracking and budgeted inference workflows; without such design, performance claims remain unverifiable and non-comparable across systems or tasks.'
